project.title: About the project
project.lead: UYCHI BINOKOR trains construction trades in Uychi district, proves skills with a QR passport and connects workers with employers.
project.goalText: To teach young people in the district a construction trade, prove their skills with a certificate anyone can check, and put them in direct touch with employers. Every stage lives in one system: application, training, attendance, grades, certificate and work.
project.for1: Young people of Uychi district who want to learn a trade
project.for2: Experienced workers who have no certificate
project.for3: Employers looking for workers and crews
project.s1: The online application takes 3 steps. The system suggests a path and a person confirms the decision.
project.s2: A group has at most 10 learners, and a mentor looks after at most 10 active learners.
project.s3: 6–12 months: theory, workshop and practice on site. Attendance and grades are recorded for every lesson.
project.s4: When the requirements are met, the certificate is issued with the director's and partners' signatures and can be checked by QR.
project.s5: Employers find workers in the catalogue and send offers. The district employment assistance office helps with placement.
project.durationText: Every course lasts between 6 and 12 months.
project.durationFast: People who already have both a trade and the language can take an accelerated path of 3 months. A person confirms the decision.
project.statsNote: The figures come from the platform database.
project.reqTitle: What it takes to get a certificate
project.req3: At least 60 points in the theory exam
project.req4: At least 70 points in the practical exam
project.req5: Complete the required practice hours on site
project.trustTitle: Why you can trust a certificate
project.trustText: Every certificate is digitally signed. The signature QR appears only after the director and partner organisations have signed. Anyone can check it by number or QR.
project.employmentText: Employers find verified workers and ready crews; candidates' phone numbers are never shown. The district employment assistance office helps graduates find jobs. Placement abroad goes only through the agency.
project.a1: Young people of Uychi district and anyone who wants to learn a construction trade. You apply online.
project.a2: From 6 to 12 months, or 3 months for people who already have both a trade and the language.
project.q3: How do I check a certificate?
project.a3: Enter the certificate number or scan the QR on the “Verify certificate” page.
project.a4: Employers find workers in the catalogue themselves. The district employment assistance office helps with placement.
